sup:70530.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Our bottom-up cost model puts the full cost of this part at EUR 403.21 per unit (cost:350020).
Your rolling scorecard shows on-time delivery of 84.6% (sc:70530@2026Q3).
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have carefully analyzed your data regarding the cost model, delivery performance, and volume forecast. Material accounts for about 42 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. As to the delivery record and volume change and should cost data you cited, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. We accept your proposed 36-month contract and 90-day payment terms, which enables us to adjust our offer to €432.15 per unit. This proposal reflects a fair accommodation of your verified parameters while maintaining the reliability of our supply. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our Angebot comprises a price of €432.15 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your revised offer and have verified the historical purchase order data you provided. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.

As our management has frozen price reductions until December 2027, we are unable to lower the price further for the current terms. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION. Therefore, we must hold our offer at a price of €432.15 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
